definitions.explanation: A sensation of coldness felt in the body, often as a symptom of fever or illness. Can also refer to a shiver caused by fear or revulsion.

examples.japanese: {熱|ねつ}が{出|で}る{前|まえ}に{寒気|さむけ}を{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt chills before the fever started.

examples.japanese: あの{怖|こわ}い{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いて、{背筋|せすじ}に{寒気|さむけ}が{走|はし}った。
examples.english: A chill ran down my spine when I heard that scary story.

notes:
READING:
The same kanji {寒気|かんき} read as かんき means cold air or cold weather, which is a different word. This entry covers the さむけ reading only.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒気|さむけ}がする (to feel a chill)
- {寒気|さむけ}を{感|かん}じる (to sense chills)
- {背筋|せすじ}に{寒気|さむけ}が{走|はし}る (a chill runs down one's spine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪寒|おかん}: chills (from illness) — more medical, specifically refers to fever-related chills
- {鳥肌|とりはだ}: goosebumps — the physical skin reaction from cold or fear
